rules.title: Scala 2.11 reached end of life
rules.summary: The Scala project's development guarantees page states that Scala 2.11 reached end-of-life in 2016. It remains available in some contexts, but it is no longer maintained.

constraints: Keep .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI setup-java / setup-scala versions, and container images on one supported Scala release line.
Confirm libraryDependencies cross-build or resolve on the target Scala and re-resolve with sbt after changing the runtime.

steps.title: Raise the Scala version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from Scala 2.11 to a supported release (see the replacement), using the project's existing version manager or sbt setting.

steps.title: Align other Scala version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI matrices, and Dockerfile Scala images so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Scala runtime is the intended release.
Compile the project on the new Scala.
Run the sbt test suite on the new Scala.

rules.title: Scala 3.0–3.2 no longer receive patches
rules.summary: The Scala project's development guarantees page states that a non-LTS Scala 3 minor receives patches only until the next minor ships. Scala 3.0, 3.1, and 3.2 are frozen on their last patches; later fixes landed only in 3.3 LTS and newer lines.
rules.replacement: Scala 3.3 LTS or a current Scala Next / LTS line

constraints: Keep .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI matrices, and container images on one supported Scala 3 LTS or Next line.
Confirm dependencies publish for the target Scala 3 line and re-resolve with sbt after changing the runtime.

steps.title: Raise the Scala version
steps.instructions: Change the reported declaration from Scala 3.0–3.2 to a supported release (see the replacement).

steps.title: Align other Scala version surfaces
steps.instructions: Update .scala-version, build.sbt scalaVersion, CI matrices, and Dockerfile Scala images so they agree.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active Scala runtime is the intended release.
Compile the project on the new Scala.
Run the sbt test suite on the new Scala.

rules.title: sbt 0.13 reached end of life
rules.summary: The sbt download page lists the 0.13.x series as end of life on 2018-11-30 after five years. The final release in that line is 0.13.18.

constraints: Keep project/build.properties sbt.version, the installed sbt launcher, and CI sbt setup on one supported sbt major.
Migrate build definitions away from 0.13-only syntax before raising sbt.version; see the migration guide.

steps.title: Raise the sbt version
steps.instructions: Change project/build.properties sbt.version from 0.13.x to a supported release (see the replacement).

steps.title: Migrate the build definition
steps.instructions: Apply the sbt 0.13 → 1.x migration guide for operators, Build.scala layouts, and plugins, then re-resolve plugins.

verification.purpose: Confirm the active sbt version is the intended release.
Compile the project on the new sbt.
Run the sbt test suite on the new sbt.
